source.boundaryTitle: Official does not mean universal truth

authority.scopeText: This placeholder demonstrates responsibility and exclusions. It establishes no official standing.
authority.boundaryText: A scientific or international source cannot establish legal permission outside the competent jurisdiction.

governance.title: Knowledge earns trust through visible governance.
governance.lede: The Constitution sets boundaries. KAS governs authored knowledge. KGS governs people and decisions. ADR and RAS retain architecture and Runtime authority.
governance.systemText: These summaries do not change or replace repository authorities.
governance.constitutionText: Highest normative authority within knowledge governance.
governance.kasText: Evidence, records, citations, terminology, relationships, and lifecycle.
governance.kgsText: People, authority, review, publication, conflicts, and accountability.
governance.adrText: Accepted durable architectural choices and consequences.
governance.rasText: Normative engineering contracts for the implemented Runtime.
governance.principlesText: Evidence-first, deterministic, explainable, and boundary-conscious doctrine.
governance.scopedStandardsText: KGS governs people; KAS governs authored knowledge.
governance.competentReviewText: Scientific, evidence, terminology, ontology, domain, and editorial authorities remain distinct.
governance.boundaryText: This page visualizes governance; it does not execute review or authorize publication.

about.title: A transparent foundation for crop-protection knowledge.
about.lede: CP-MoAKB makes meaning, evidence, authority, uncertainty, and lifecycle inspectable before future knowledge is used.
about.summaryText: A governed scientific knowledge platform under construction with deterministic engineering and evidence-first human governance.
about.architectureText: The product experience exposes the separation already established by repository architecture.
about.experienceText: Search, browse, concepts, evidence, authority, and governance in this static prototype.
about.knowledgeGovernanceText: Constitution, KAS, KGS, source policy, review, and publication decisions.
about.conceptualText: Implementation-neutral ontology, identity, terminology, and relationship boundaries.
about.engineeringText: Deterministic Runtime contracts remain unchanged by this prototype.
about.officialSourcesText: Retained, versioned, integrity-checked reference material within its governed scope.
about.nowText: Constitution, authoring standards, governance standards, and product vision.
about.nextText: Handbooks, review framework, and authoring templates—each separately authorized.
about.laterText: Candidate-only learning before any domain population or implementation mapping.
